overview: This file consists of a single “List of Papers” sheet concerning aviation facilities in the Kwantung Leased Territory. It records an April 25 despatch from Dairen, attributed to Grummon and addressed to the Embassy, about the erection of a radio beacon near Chou-shuitzu, the Dairen airport; the underlying despatch was filed or cross-referenced under 8940.821/1 rather than reproduced here.

people.name: Grummon
people.role: Author or responsible officer for the Dairen despatch; precise position not stated

subfiles.title: List of Papers: Radio beacon near Chou-shuitzu airport
subfiles.about: An index entry records an April 25 despatch concerning the erection of a radio beacon near Chou-shuitzu, the Dairen airport.
subfiles.summary: The sheet identifies the subject as stations and landing fields in the Kwantung Leased Territory. It lists a despatch sent from Dairen to the Embassy on April 25 and associates it with Grummon. The despatch reported the erection of a radio beacon near Chou-shuitzu and is cross-referenced to file 8940.821/1.

interest: Although the substantive despatch is absent, this index sheet documents the installation of radio-navigation infrastructure at Dairen’s Chou-shuitzu airport. It is useful for tracing the development of aviation facilities in the Japanese-controlled Kwantung Leased Territory and, through the reference to 8940.821/1, for locating the fuller diplomatic report elsewhere in the decimal file.
